facts.fact: A Hespress interview with academic Adel Ben Hamza (published 2026-07-30) says Morocco's legislator wrote into the revised electoral framework for the 2026 legislative elections provisions that criminalise use of AI and digital means to alter the truth or harm the private lives of individuals and candidates, and excluded electoral offences from alternative penalties; it names no law or article, and the date is the publication date.
facts.system: Revised electoral legal framework for the 2026 legislative elections (AI disinformation provisions)
